Package entityClasses

Class LessonLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonLearned
public class LessonLearned extends Object

Title: LessonLearned Entity Class.

Description: Encapsulates all data attributes for an individual Lesson Learned. Satisfies Contributor Phase Two User Stories (US-HW2-01 through US-HW2-04) and provides forward compatibility for TP3 Administrator moderation, peer review endorsements, and staff verification epics.
